tools.name: get_services_overview
tools.description: Get a summary of the services Jono Alderson offers, including consulting and public speaking. Returns the URLs and short descriptions for each. Use this when a user asks 'what does Jono do', 'can I hire him', or wants the link to the consulting or speaking page.

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: List Jono Alderson's most recent published articles. Returns titles, URLs, excerpts, and publication dates. Useful when a user asks 'what has Jono written recently' or wants to browse the blog.

tools.name: start_consulting_enquiry
tools.description: Take the visitor to Jono Alderson's consulting page to start a consulting enquiry. Use this when a user expresses interest in hiring Jono for SEO, performance, or structured data work.

tools.name: start_contact_enquiry
tools.description: Start a contact enquiry with Jono Alderson. Optionally pre-fills the name, email, subject, and message fields. If the visitor is not yet on the contact page, takes them there with the prefill preserved. Does not submit the form - the visitor must review and submit it.

tools.name: start_speaker_enquiry
tools.description: Take the visitor to Jono Alderson's speaking page to start a speaker booking enquiry. Use this when a user wants to invite Jono to keynote or speak at an event.
